title: Multimodal Sense-Informed Forecasting of 3D Human Motions
problem: Forecast plausible 3D futures using more than pose history alone.
keyIdea: Fuse complementary sensory cues to reduce future-motion ambiguity.
io: Past motion + multimodal observations → future 3D motion.
methodNote: Multimodal encoders condition a generative forecasting model.
contribution: Shows that sense-informed context improves long-horizon forecasting.
limitation: Requires synchronized context modalities that may be unavailable in the wild.
embodied: High: anticipatory robots can use the forecast for safer planning.

title: Scene-responsive Diverse Human Motion Prediction
problem: Predict diverse futures that remain physically compatible with 3D scenes.
keyIdea: Make stochastic motion sampling explicitly responsive to scene geometry.
io: Past motion + 3D scene → diverse future motions.
methodNote: A scene-conditioned diffusion framework models multimodal futures.
contribution: Bridges diversity and scene feasibility in human motion prediction.
limitation: Performance depends on scene reconstruction quality.
embodied: High: directly supports collision-aware human–robot coexistence.

title: WANDR: Intention-guided Human Motion Generation
problem: Generate goal-directed locomotion and reaching without fixed trajectories.
keyIdea: Represent intention as spatial targets and synthesize motion that adapts online.
io: Motion state + target intention → goal-reaching future motion.
methodNote: A learned autoregressive controller models diverse intention-conditioned motion.
contribution: Supports flexible, scene-aware reaching from high-level goals.
limitation: Targets are simpler than free-form semantic intentions.
embodied: High: resembles goal-conditioned action generation for embodied agents.

title: Generating Human Motion in 3D Scenes from Text Descriptions
problem: Generate motion that obeys both language and 3D scene constraints.
keyIdea: Use an object-centric scene representation to ground text in interaction targets.
methodNote: A conditional generative model aligns language, target objects, and motion.
contribution: Improves semantic and geometric consistency of scene-conditioned synthesis.
limitation: Static scenes and annotated target objects constrain generality.
embodied: High: connects language grounding, affordance, and physical action.

title: Move as You Say, Interact as You Can
problem: Synthesize language-guided motion with credible scene contact.
keyIdea: Condition motion generation on explicit scene affordance maps.
io: Language + 3D scene affordance → human–scene interaction motion.
methodNote: Affordance prediction and diffusion-based motion synthesis are coupled.
contribution: Makes scene affordance a first-class condition for motion generation.
limitation: Affordance errors propagate into motion and contact quality.
embodied: High: affordance-grounded action is central to robot manipulation and HRI.

title: Scaling Up Dynamic Human-Scene Interaction Modeling
problem: Learn long, diverse interactions in dynamic 3D environments at scale.
keyIdea: Pair a large dynamic HSI dataset with scalable motion modeling.
io: Scene + interaction specification → long human–scene motion.
methodNote: A data-centric generative pipeline models dynamic scene interactions.
contribution: Introduces TRUMANS and expands HSI beyond small static datasets.
limitation: Synthetic data still leaves a sim-to-real gap.
embodied: High: valuable for world models and humanoid policy pretraining.

title: InterControl: Zero-shot Human Interaction Generation by Controlling Every Joint
problem: Generate coherent interactions for an arbitrary number of people.
keyIdea: Translate interactions into controllable inter-person joint-distance constraints.
io: Text + joint relations → multi-person interaction motion.
methodNote: A motion controller and inverse-kinematics guidance steer a pretrained diffusion prior.
contribution: Achieves zero-shot multi-human interaction without fixed-person training data.
limitation: Joint constraints do not fully encode social intent or contact physics.
embodied: Medium-high: useful for social navigation and multi-agent behavior simulation.

title: InterDreamer: Zero-Shot Text to 3D Dynamic Human-Object Interaction
problem: Create dynamic HOI without paired text–interaction training data.
keyIdea: Decouple semantic planning from low-level interaction dynamics using pretrained models and a world model.
io: Text + object state → joint human and object motion.
methodNote: LLM and text-to-motion priors provide semantics; a learned world model enforces dynamics.
limitation: Simple learned physics cannot cover complex contacts and articulated objects.
embodied: Very high: explicitly links language, world dynamics, and action.

title: Vision-Guided Action: Enhancing 3D Human Motion Prediction with Gaze-informed Affordance
problem: Infer where a person will act before their pose makes the goal obvious.
keyIdea: Use gaze to discover scene affordances that condition future motion.
io: Past motion + gaze + scene → future 3D motion.
methodNote: Gaze-informed affordance features guide a scene-conditioned predictor.
contribution: Connects visual attention, intention, affordance, and motion forecasting.
limitation: Relies on reliable gaze estimation and visible target regions.
embodied: Very high: anticipatory HRI depends on early intent and affordance inference.

title: Efficient Multi-Person Motion Prediction by Lightweight Spatial and Temporal Interactions
problem: Predict multiple people jointly without heavy interaction modeling.
keyIdea: Factor lightweight spatial and temporal interaction modules.
io: Past multi-person skeletons → future multi-person motion.
methodNote: Efficient relation modeling captures inter-person and temporal dependencies.
contribution: Improves the accuracy–efficiency trade-off for multi-person forecasting.
limitation: No explicit scene or semantic intent grounding.
embodied: High: efficient social-motion prediction is deployable on robot platforms.

title: Move-in-2D: 2D-Conditioned Human Motion Generation
problem: Generate 3D motion grounded in an ordinary scene image.
keyIdea: Use 2D scene cues and text as accessible conditions for 3D motion diffusion.
methodNote: A conditional diffusion model learns from a large image-aligned motion dataset.
contribution: Avoids requiring a reconstructed 3D scene at inference time.
limitation: Depth ambiguity can cause weak 3D contact and occlusion errors.
embodied: Medium-high: offers cheap visual grounding but limited metric geometry.

title: SemGeoMo: Dynamic Contextual Human Motion Generation with Semantic and Geometric Guidance
problem: Generate motion that follows semantics while respecting changing geometry.
keyIdea: Jointly guide motion using text, affordance, and joint-level geometry.
io: Text + dynamic scene context → context-consistent motion.
methodNote: Multi-level semantic and geometric conditions steer diffusion sampling.
contribution: Treats context as dynamic rather than a fixed scene backdrop.
limitation: Complex conditioning increases data and compute demands.
embodied: Very high: dynamic context is closer to real robot environments.

title: HSI-GPT: A General-Purpose Large Scene-Motion-Language Model for Human Scene Interaction
problem: Unify heterogeneous scene, language, and motion tasks in one model.
keyIdea: Tokenize and align scene–motion–language so an LLM can perform next-token reasoning.
io: Scene/motion/language prompt → motion or multimodal response.
methodNote: Multimodal pretraining and instruction tuning align all modalities in an LLM space.
contribution: Moves HSI from task-specific generators toward a general-purpose model.
limitation: Large-model cost and tokenization can weaken precise physical contact.
embodied: Very high: a direct step toward multimodal embodied foundation models.

title: InterAct: Advancing Large-Scale Versatile 3D Human-Object Interaction Generation
problem: Scale dynamic 3D HOI generation across more objects and actions.
keyIdea: Build a versatile HOI dataset and jointly model human and object motion.
methodNote: A joint generative model captures coupled body and object dynamics.
contribution: Broadens data scale and interaction diversity for HOI generation.
limitation: Dataset object and interaction coverage remains finite.
embodied: Very high: coupled agent–object dynamics are central to manipulation.

title: ChainHOI: Joint-based Kinematic Chain Modeling for Human-Object Interaction Generation
problem: Generate fine-grained interactions with accurate body–object relations.
keyIdea: Represent HOI through object-conditioned body kinematic chains.
io: Text + object geometry → human and object interaction motion.
methodNote: Joint-centric chain modeling guides a generative motion backbone.
contribution: Improves interaction fidelity beyond body-only motion quality.
limitation: Kinematic quality does not guarantee physically stable forces.
embodied: High: offers structured contact priors for robot learning.

title: InterPhys: Physics-aware Human Motion Synthesis in a Dynamic Scene
problem: Synthesize credible interaction when scene objects themselves move.
keyIdea: Inject physics-aware constraints into dynamic-scene motion generation.
io: Human/object state + dynamic scene → physically plausible interaction motion.
methodNote: A generative model couples motion synthesis with physical interaction guidance.
contribution: Extends scene-aware synthesis from static geometry to dynamic environments.
limitation: Approximate physics still struggles with complex contact and deformation.
embodied: Very high: models the closed-loop dynamics missing from static HSI work.

title: Stability-Driven Motion Generation for Object-Guided Human-Human Co-Manipulation
problem: Generate coordinated two-person motion that keeps a shared object stable.
keyIdea: Use object stability as the organizing constraint for cooperative motion.
io: Shared object trajectory/context → coordinated human–human motion.
methodNote: Stability-aware guidance shapes a conditional motion generator.
contribution: Links interaction synthesis with task-level cooperative stability.
limitation: Designed around co-manipulation and may not generalize to broader social motion.
embodied: Very high: immediately relevant to human–robot collaborative carrying.

title: ViHOI: Human-Object Interaction Synthesis with Visual Priors
problem: Ground HOI synthesis in rich object appearance and geometry cues.
keyIdea: Inject visual and textual priors into a diffusion interaction generator.
io: Object visual prior + text → 3D human–object interaction.
methodNote: Self-attention fuses visual/text priors within diffusion generation.
contribution: Uses pretrained visual knowledge to improve open-world HOI grounding.
limitation: Visual priors may describe appearance better than contact dynamics.
embodied: High: visually grounded interaction transfers naturally to robot perception.
